en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own nursing route and get the same costed plan, from NMC fees to the family-later budget
en.runTitle: Cebu to NHS England: a registered nurse with 4 years on the ward and PHP 350,000, aiming to start around September 2027

fields.label: Qualification and PRC status
fields.value: Registered nurse in Cebu with 4 years of ward experience

fields.label: English scores and test dates
fields.placeholder: e.g. IELTS Academic booked for March 2027

fields.label: CBT / NMC stage
fields.placeholder: e.g. qualification evaluation submitted, CBT not yet booked

fields.label: Written trust offer and repayment terms
fields.placeholder: e.g. offer letter with a 2-year repayment clause

fields.label: Who prepays each cost
fields.placeholder: e.g. trust pays the visa and flight; I pay the NMC fees

fields.label: Philippine deployment route
fields.placeholder: e.g. direct hire with a UK trust

fields.label: Family ages and joining plans
fields.value: Nobody at first; her husband and child might join later

en.template: Help me plan a Philippine-to-NHS England move using {qualification}, {english}, {cbt}, {start}, {savings}, {offer}, {prepay}, {route} and {family}. Compare upfront cash with reimbursement, protect maintenance evidence, check the registration and sponsorship clocks, and show a delayed-start and family-later budget. Flag unconfirmed requirements. Ask before contacting anyone, applying, booking or sharing documents.

phases.title: Read the official NMC, GOV.UK, NHS Employers and Philippine pages on registration, visa and pay
Build the costed guide: who pays what, first-year pay and a family-later budget
phases.judgment: Two traps were avoided: the registration fees come from the dated 1 October 2026 page (GBP 1,226 in total), not from older pages that still show GBP 140 and GBP 153; and the guide declines to promise settlement in September 2032, because the settlement rules are being changed.

phases.title: Recheck every figure with a separate calculation, test desktop and phone layouts, and deliver
phases.judgment: The recheck caught two rounding slips in the pay table and fixed them; all 70 checks then passed. The independent reviewer was interrupted, so the guide says plainly that no outside review is claimed, and lists the Philippine departure paperwork as still unconfirmed.

workers: Read the NMC pages on the registration steps, fees, timing and the English test options and scores
Read the official visa rules: fees, the maintenance funds rule, family joining later, the TB test and what trusts may charge back
Assigned an independent recomputation of every money figure; this review was interrupted, so a separate scripted check covered the arithmetic instead
